---
name: Schema discussion
about: Propose a schema change — new enum value, new property, structural change
title: "[Schema] "
labels: schema
---

## Proposal

What change are you proposing? (New enum value, new property, structural modification, etc.)

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Which entries are poorly served by the current schema?

## Examples

List 3+ existing entries that would be affected by this change, and how their coding would change.

| Entry | Current coding | Proposed coding |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

## Trade-offs

- What analytical clarity does this add?
- What complexity does it introduce?
- Is this a breaking change? (See CHANGELOG.md for what past schema changes involved.)

## Notes

Any additional context. If this is an enum addition (non-breaking), it can ship in a point release. If it's a property addition or structural change, it warrants broader discussion first.
